market.basis: heading names the planning region (a county equivalent); legacy-county composition is an approximation

ct.basis_legacy: approximation from legacy counties; a town-level crosswalk is needed for exactness
ct.fit_legacy: approximate: Northwest Hills covers most of Litchfield County, but some Litchfield towns sit in Western Connecticut and Naugatuck Valley
ct.fit_planning: exact: heading names Northwest Hills, the Northwest Hills Planning Region

market.reason: Planning region is exact; Litchfield County is a close but not exact legacy match.
